newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Herdez raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Herdez raised to buy.

text.p: -- Abaco/Rodman brokerage upgraded Grupo Herdez to buy from long-term buy, the brokerage said in a statement Wednesday.
-- The rating change follows the company's purchase of a sardine plant in the state of Sonora.
-- "We believe that Herdez's acquisition and other growth strategies have been very positive and should improve its operating results in the short term," analyst Marcela Martnez said.
-- Herdez's shares closed Monday at 3.42 pesos.
